description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 9, 2015 SAN PEDRO, CA – Last week, Nanette Barragán, congressional candidate in California’s 44th District, released her second quarter fundraising numbers. Since she announced her congressional campaign in April, she raised more than $160,000 - more than what her opponent, state Senator Isadore Hall III, raised in his first report. Hall
title: Barragán’s First Fundraising Report Outpaces Hall’s First Fundraising Report in CA-44 - Nanette Barragan For Congress (CA-44)
